quote: Crossing is the Away Register in which the expedition studies the highway through its Core Species body, commits the whole party to one complete plan, and executes that plan as a single continuous run.
claim: Crossing is the Away Register in which the expedition studies the highway through its Core Species body, commits the whole party to one complete plan, and executes that plan as a single continuous run.

quote: The party resolves globally; bodily adversity attaches to individual Citizens;
claim: The party resolves globally while bodily adversity attaches to individual Citizens.

quote: attachment-bearing objects are never silently lost.
claim: Attachment-bearing objects are never silently lost.

quote: Crossing is not an ordinary Field leg and not a turn-based MEET. It is a short, high-attention threshold Register where human-scale traffic becomes immediate bodily danger. Its complexity belongs primarily in perception and planning, followed by irreversible execution and compact resolution.
claim: Crossing is a short, high-attention threshold Register (neither an ordinary Field leg nor a turn-based MEET) where human-scale traffic becomes immediate bodily danger, with complexity concentrated in perception and planning followed by irreversible execution and compact resolution.

quote: Field determines where an expedition travels; Crossing determines whether the party can pass the defining barrier between territories.

claim: Crossing itself does not acquire turn structure.

quote: Planning — observe the road, inspect party state, and construct one complete species-conditioned solution.

quote: Commitment — explicitly accept the plan; after commitment, strategic revision ends.
claim: Commitment is the phase of explicitly accepting the plan, after which strategic revision ends.

quote: Continuous Run — the party performs the complete passage as one embodied event.
claim: Continuous Run is the phase in which the party performs the complete passage as one embodied event.

quote: Resolution — determine global party outcome, individual adversity, and material consequences.
claim: Resolution is the phase that determines global party outcome, individual adversity, and material consequences.

quote: The road does not wait while the player takes turns.
claim: The road does not wait while the player takes turns.

quote: Any execution input expresses carrying out the chosen plan rather than creating a second strategic layer.
claim: Any execution input expresses carrying out the chosen plan rather than creating a second strategic layer.

quote: An expedition party contains three body units.
claim: An expedition party contains three body units.

quote: Crossing therefore does not use waves, separate activations, or elaborate formations.
claim: Crossing does not use waves, separate activations, or elaborate formations.

claim: Execution is staged primarily through one foreground runner while the remaining body units remain visible behind or adjacent.

claim: The foreground runner is a camera and staging role, not a permanent leader or superior Citizen.

claim: The party succeeds or fails globally, while adversity may attach to particular Citizens.

quote: Mouse parties may show six named Mice as three compact pairs or a short chain without granting six separate Crossing actions.
claim: Mouse parties may show six named Mice as three compact pairs or a short chain without granting six separate Crossing actions.

quote: The same highway is one underlying traffic and environmental simulation, but each Core Species exposes a different playable truth.
claim: The highway is one underlying traffic and environmental simulation, but each Core Species exposes a different playable truth.

quote: The shared contour remains Planning → Commit → Run → Resolve.
claim: The shared contour across species remains Planning → Commit → Run → Resolve.

quote: Rabbit | When does the road open? | One macro traffic window and broad line | One full-carriageway sprint | The inferred window does not remain sufficient for the whole party
claim: For Rabbit, the primary planning question is when the road opens, planning one macro traffic window and broad line, executed as one full-carriageway sprint, with characteristic failure being that the inferred window does not remain sufficient for the whole party.

quote: Mouse | Where can continuity be made? | A chain of 3–6 pavement-scale waypoints | One continuous chained scurry | The route loses contact, legibility, or viable continuity
claim: For Mouse, the primary planning question is where continuity can be made, planning a chain of 3–6 pavement-scale waypoints, executed as one continuous chained scurry, with characteristic failure being that the route loses contact, legibility, or viable continuity.

quote: Squirrel | How does the route move through traffic? | A flowing trajectory with limited predeclared redirection | One continuous vector run | The moving trajectory ceases to remain viable
claim: For Squirrel, the primary planning question is how the route moves through traffic, planning a flowing trajectory with limited predeclared redirection, executed as one continuous vector run, with characteristic failure being that the moving trajectory ceases to remain viable.

quote: Rabbit Crossing treats the highway as one temporal opening. The player selects a launch moment, broad crossing line, and far-side destination, then commits to one complete sprint.
claim: Rabbit Crossing treats the highway as one temporal opening: during planning the Rabbit remains visibly still while vehicle echoes, blur, and overlapping motion traces accumulate into readable traffic patterns, and the player selects a launch moment, broad crossing line, and far-side destination before committing to one complete sprint.

quote: The blur represents accumulated observation and Rabbit stillness, not literal foresight.
claim: The blur represents accumulated observation and Rabbit stillness, not literal foresight.

quote: Execution should be brief, fast, and minimally revisable.
claim: Execution should be brief, fast, and minimally revisable.

quote: Rabbit Field speed is pro-rated by Rabbit body units in the party;

quote: the exact conversion from Rabbit composition to Crossing acuity remains provisional.
claim: The exact conversion from Rabbit composition to Crossing acuity remains provisional.

quote: Mouse Crossing zooms from the whole roadway into pavement-scale topology. The player designates a limited chain of meaningful waypoints such as cracks, seams, depressions, paint edges, small debris, drainage cuts, curb defects, or stable shadow boundaries.
claim: Mouse Crossing zooms from the whole roadway into pavement-scale topology, with the player designating a limited chain of meaningful waypoints such as cracks, seams, depressions, paint edges, small debris, drainage cuts, curb defects, or stable shadow boundaries.

quote: Waypoints may provide true refuge, tactile contact, orientation, or only temporary legibility; they are not universal safety tiles.
claim: Waypoints may provide true refuge, tactile contact, orientation, or only temporary legibility; they are not universal safety tiles.

quote: More waypoints can improve continuity but also lengthen exposure or produce awkward deviations.
claim: More waypoints can improve continuity but also lengthen exposure or produce awkward deviations.

quote: After commitment, the Mouse party executes the whole chain continuously; planning does not reopen at each point.
claim: After commitment, the Mouse party executes the whole chain continuously; planning does not reopen at each point.

claim: Mouse subjective time may expand during execution, with vibration, shadow, tire noise, and short distances becoming densely perceptible.

quote: This grants no extra actions or decisions. Mouse perceives more moments; the player does not receive more turns.
claim: Mouse's expanded subjective time grants no extra actions or decisions; Mouse perceives more moments but the player does not receive more turns.

quote: Squirrel does not require convenient vertical anchors in the middle of an ordinary highway. claim: Squirrel's Crossing distinction is a flowing route through moving traffic geometry, not requiring convenient vertical anchors, where the player defines a trajectory—potentially with one or two predeclared redirects—exploiting vehicle wakes, relative motion, and a far-side climbable refuge or anchor.

quote: Rabbit waits for a sufficiently broad window across the highway.
claim: Rabbit waits for a sufficiently broad window across the highway.

quote: Mouse assembles continuity from fixed micro-features.
claim: Mouse assembles continuity from fixed micro-features.

quote: Squirrel seeks a window that moves through the highway.
claim: Squirrel seeks a window that moves through the highway.

quote: This grammar is promising but remains the least settled. It must be refined until it is more than Rabbit with a diagonal line.

claim: Crossing resolves the expedition globally, but Exposure-equivalent adversity is allocated to individual creatures.

claim: Rabbit and Squirrel Citizens use the standard full-body adversity rate.

claim: Each Mouse uses half the standard individual adversity rate, so two Mice together approximate one full body unit's adversity frequency.

claim: A normal Mouse adversity result affects one named Mouse, not an entire body unit.

claim: Mouse strength is distributed vulnerability, not immunity.

quote: Clean global success can still include individual adversity under harsh conditions;

claim: A mixed party receives Strained capacity only from its actual Squirrel body units.

A party of 2 Squirrels + 1 Guest has shared Strained Capacity of 20 and 2 Jostle Checks per Lane.
A party of 1 Squirrel + 2 Guests has shared Strained Capacity of 10 and 1 Jostle Check per Lane.

quote: At each lane, the system runs one hidden Jostle check per Squirrel body unit. Each check uses the current fill proportion of the shared Strained Inventory:

claim: Jostle chance per check equals 50% multiplied by current Strained Cargo divided by maximum Strained capacity.

quote: Full Strained Inventory: 50% per check.
claim: A full Strained Inventory yields a 50% Jostle chance per check.

quote: Half-full: 25% per check.
claim: A half-full Strained Inventory yields a 25% Jostle chance per check.

quote: Empty: no Jostle procedure.
